10. Shares of the Bank.- The authorised capital shall be divided among the subscribers in the manner set out in this section of the Act.
11.10.2018. 278 Volume XI (2001-2010) Substituted by the amending note for the words proportion to the shares of the Bank.
11. Capital of the Bank.- The capital of the Bank shall be divided in proportion to the shares held by the Government and the other subscribers of the Bank.
12. General reserve.- The Bank shall maintain a general reserve from its annual profits in the manner prescribed by this section.
17.02.2007. 2 In subsection (1) for the words the Bank the following words shall be read in this amending note.
17. Audit.- The accounts of the Bank shall be audited by auditors appointed in the manner provided by this section.
18. Annual report.- The Board shall submit an annual report of the Bank to the Government each year under this Act.
20. Meetings.- The Board shall meet as often as the business of the Bank requires and shall keep minutes of every meeting.
23.03.2019. 277 Volume XI (2001-2010) discovered to have not been qualified for appointment under this amending note.
23. Disqualification.- A person shall not be a director if he is discovered to have not been qualified for the office under this Act.
24. Removal.- The Government may remove a director in the circumstances stated in this section of the Act.
25. Rules.- The Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act in the manner stated here.
26. Repeal.- The earlier instrument on the same subject is repealed to the extent of inconsistency with this Act.
